items.source: Create a new DelegatingNavigationHandlerProxy.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 DelegatingNavigationHandlerProxy。

items.source: facesContext - the current JSF context
items.translation: facesContext - 当前的 JSF 上下文

items.source: For decorating the original NavigationHandler, make sure that your target bean extends Spring's DecoratingNavigationHandler class. This allows to pass in the original handler as method argument, which this proxy automatically detects. Note that a DecoratingNavigationHandler subclass will still work as standard JSF NavigationHandler as well!
items.translation: 对于装饰原始 NavigationHandler，请确保您的目标 bean 扩展了 Spring 的 DecoratingNavigationHandler 类。这允许将原始处理器作为方法参数传入，该代理会自动检测到此参数。请注意，DecoratingNavigationHandler 的子类仍然可以作为标准的 JSF NavigationHandler 使用！

items.source: This proxy may be subclassed to change the bean name used to search for the navigation handler, change the strategy used to obtain the target handler, or change the strategy used to access the ApplicationContext (normally obtained via FacesContextUtils.getWebApplicationContext(FacesContext)).
items.translation: 此代理可被重写以更改用于搜索导航处理器的 bean 名称、更改用于获取目标处理器的策略，或更改用于访问 ApplicationContext 的策略（通常通过 FacesContextUtils.getWebApplicationContext(FacesContext) 获取）。

items.source: The target bean needs to extend the JSF NavigationHandler class. If it extends Spring's DecoratingNavigationHandler, the overloaded handleNavigation method with the original NavigationHandler as argument will be used. Else, the standard handleNavigation method will be called.
items.translation: 目标 Bean 需要扩展 JSF NavigationHandler 类。如果它扩展了 Spring 的 DecoratingNavigationHandler，则使用带有原始 NavigationHandler 参数的重载handleNavigation方法；否则，将调用标准的handleNavigation方法。

items.source: Configure this handler proxy in your faces-config.xml file as follows:
items.translation: 在您的 `faces-config.xml` 文件中按以下方式配置此处理器代理：

items.source: Default implementation delegates to getWebApplicationContext. Can be overridden to provide an arbitrary BeanFactory reference to resolve against; usually, this will be a full Spring ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 默认实现委托给getWebApplicationContext。可以重写它以提供任意的 BeanFactory 引用进行解析；通常，这将是一个完整的 Spring ApplicationContext。

items.source:
By default, a bean with the name "jsfNavigationHandler" is obtained
from the Spring root WebApplicationContext, for every invocation.
items.translation: 默认情况下，每次调用时都会从 Spring 根 WebApplicationContext 中获取一个名为"jsfNavigationHandler"的 Bean。

items.source: Default implementation delegates to FacesContextUtils.
items.translation: 默认实现委托给 FacesContextUtils。

items.source:
Default name of the target bean in the Spring application context:
"jsfNavigationHandler".
items.translation:
Spring 应用程序上下文中目标 Bean 的默认名称：
"jsfNavigationHandler"。

items.source:
Return the name of the target NavigationHandler bean in the BeanFactory.
Default is "jsfNavigationHandler".
items.translation: 在 BeanFactory 中返回目标 NavigationHandler 豆的名称。默认值为"jsfNavigationHandler"。

items.source: originalNavigationHandler - the original NavigationHandler
items.translation: originalNavigationHandler - 原始 NavigationHandler

items.source: the Spring BeanFactory (never null)
items.translation: Spring BeanFactory（永远不为null）

items.source: the Spring web application context (never null)
items.translation: Spring Web 应用程序上下文（永远不为null）

items.source: the target NavigationHandler to delegate to
items.translation: 要委托的目标 NavigationHandler

items.source: the name of the target bean
items.translation: 目标 Bean 的名称

items.source: Retrieve the Spring BeanFactory to delegate bean name resolution to.
items.translation: 获取用于委派 Bean 名称解析的 Spring BeanFactory。

items.source: Return the target NavigationHandler to delegate to.
items.translation: 返回要委托的目标 NavigationHandler。

items.source: Return the name of the target NavigationHandler bean in the BeanFactory.
items.translation: 在 BeanFactory 中返回目标 NavigationHandler 豆的名称。

items.source: Retrieve the web application context to delegate bean name resolution to.
items.translation: 检索 Web 应用程序上下文以委托 Bean 名称解析。

items.source:
Handle the navigation request implied by the specified parameters,
through delegating to the target bean in the Spring application context.
items.translation: 通过委托给 Spring 应用上下文中的目标 Bean，处理由指定参数暗示的导航请求。

items.translation: jakarta.faces.application.NavigationHandler 类中的 handleNavigation
